scope.statement: Read-only verification of the canonical native04 four-file copy receipt, exact private04 byte identity, and the recorded canonical 43-test result. This review supplies source-only disposition and no runtime or qualification authority.

canonical_test_receipt.verification: The root-recorded 43/43 result and log digest were checked against the canonical copy receipt; the suite was not rerun because all four canonical files were independently byte-identical to frozen private04.

observations: The canonical directory contains exactly the four receipt-listed regular source files.
Each canonical file matches its private04 source byte-for-byte and recorded SHA256.
The copy receipt binds the private04 handoff and private04 source review by exact SHA256.
The bound source review grants source_commit_approval only and keeps execution, qualification, automatic retry and publication held.
The canonical test receipt has exit_code 0, 43 passed of 43 total, and the exact recorded log SHA256.

findings.finding: All four canonical native04 files match the frozen private04 source bytes and receipt-listed hashes exactly.
findings.required_preservation: Preserve these exact four canonical bytes and the private04 source-review binding through root's later source commit review.

findings.finding: The canonical copy receipt records a successful 43/43 native04 test suite, and its immutable log digest matches the independent receipt verification. No test rerun was necessary after exact byte identity was established.
findings.required_preservation: Retain the separate source-test receipt and do not reinterpret this synthetic suite as native-control, analyzer, qualification or release evidence.

findings.finding: This review establishes canonical byte-copy and recorded source-test integrity only. It does not establish source commit completion, runtime integration, native-control qualification, fresh admission, production dispatch, analyzer success, release readiness or publication readiness.
findings.required_preservation: Keep execution_authorized=false, qualification_performed=false, automatic_retry=false and publication_hold=true in the copy/next-gate chain.

disposition.source_commit_scope: The exact four canonical native04 files may proceed to root's separate source commit and final selection review.
disposition.next_gate: Root performs the subsequent selected-source commit, request/source-closure/namespace binding and exact invocation review; later runtime control and qualification remain separate gates.
